purpose: Stable authoritative workspace input for source validation and demo rehearsal; not evidence of autonomous routing, native delegation, persistence, or rendered pixels.

workspace.brief: Create a calm launch-planning workspace that makes tradeoffs visible and supports targeted iteration.

directions.name: Quiet Systems
directions.premise: A restrained token-led workspace with strong hierarchy and low visual noise.
directions.interaction: Select a system layer, inspect its tokens, and refine only that layer.

frames.label: Desktop
frames.notes: Wide comparison canvas with persistent token inspector.

frames.label: Mobile
frames.notes: Single-column system layers with a collapsible inspector.

directions.name: Guided Momentum
directions.premise: A task-forward workspace that turns the launch sequence into explicit next actions.
directions.interaction: Move between milestones and issue targeted refinement requests.

frames.label: Desktop
frames.notes: Milestone rail beside the active launch decision.

frames.label: Mobile
frames.notes: Focused next-action view with thumb-reachable milestone controls.

directions.name: Editorial Field
directions.premise: An editorial canvas that pairs narrative intent with concrete launch decisions.
directions.interaction: Compare story panels and save the chosen composition.

frames.label: Desktop
frames.notes: Editorial spread with decisions pinned beside narrative panels.

frames.label: Mobile
frames.notes: Stacked story panels with an anchored decision summary.
